entities.name: Thomas Reynolds
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Reynolds was an American politician and lawyer who was the chief justice of the Illinois Supreme Court as well as the seventh governor of Missouri. A Democrat, he is notable for being one of the few American politicians to die by suicide while in office.
